items.summary: بوچنن نے 2021 سے 2023 کے دوران بڑی ٹیکنالوجی اور ٹیلی مواصلاتی کمپنیوں کے ملازمین کو سیکڑوں جعلی پیغامات بھیجے

items.title: Bitcoin outpaces gold even as both assets tumble ahead of a likely Fed rate hike
items.summary: Bitcoin held near $64,000 as gold fell 2%, lifting the ratio between the two above its 200-day moving average and extending a series of higher lows since March.

items.title: NI will carry momentum into Euro 2028 qualifiers
items.summary: Northern Ireland manager Michael O'Neill says his Nations League promotion winners will plot their next 12 months after the Euro 2028 qualifying draw in December.
